scope: Prospective admission contract for future decider candidates. The accompanying published-method audit is background analysis, not a preregistered experiment.

input_contract.formula: Any finite explicitly encoded signed CNF under this convention; no polarity, incidence, width, treewidth, rank or source-subclass restriction.

edge_cases.unused_variable: arbitrary value in a full witness

input_contract.L: Original input bit length under a fixed explicit encoding. Validation, renumbering and preprocessing are charged.
input_contract.padding: Repeated literal occurrences suffice if exactly three occurrences are required. A distinct-variable exactly-3 convention needs an explicit constant-size padding construction and revised counts.

candidate_slot.name: E8-D1_UNRESTRICTED_SIGNED_3CNF_DECIDER_CANDIDATE_V1
required_submission: Full deterministic Decide(Phi) pseudocode returning SAT or UNSAT.
All subroutines specified without semantic oracles.
Original-input state semantics and reconstruction rule.
Four separate proofs D1-SOUND, D1-COMPLETE, D1-TERMINATES, D1-POLY.
Candidate content hash frozen before candidate-specific experiments.

D1-SOUND.requirement: Every returned SAT answer has a satisfying assignment; witness reconstruction and original-input verification must be correct.

D1-COMPLETE.requirement: Every satisfiable input returns SAT and every unsatisfiable input returns UNSAT, with no unhandled valid-input class.

D1-TERMINATES.requirement: A proof that the exact algorithm terminates on every valid input, including UNSAT and edge cases.

D1-POLY.requirement: One uniform bit-cost algorithm and fixed constants C,k independent of Phi, with total work at most C*(L+1)^k on every input.

resource_contract.query_history: For an external history H, budget is polynomial in L+|H|. A one-input SAT proof must bound the number and total size of its own queries by a fixed polynomial in L.
forbidden_shortcuts: exhaustive subset/assignment enumeration as an admitted E8 core
unbounded branching presented as polynomial merely because it is memoized
running time polynomial only in an exponentially expanded representation
resource_contract.semantic_merge_rule: Each merge needs an explicitly implemented, sound test and a charged polynomial total cost. A polynomial certificate verifier alone does not provide a polynomial certificate constructor.
resource_contract.incomplete_certificate_test: A sound polynomial sufficient test may decline to merge. Then completeness and total runtime of the surrounding algorithm, including all missed merges, must still be proved.
resource_contract.representation_scope: No mandatory OBDD/d-DNNF/flat CNF, unique canonical residual, counting algorithm, or enumeration of all future states.

four_list_coloring_encoding.authority: Standard exact encoding described in the source audit; not a SAT solver.

search_from_decision.authority: Standard SAT self-reduction; conditional on an already correct polynomial decider.

admission.open: Any missing proof leaves the universal claim OPEN.
admission.failure: A counterexample or superpolynomial execution bound rejects only the specified candidate.
admission.finite_tests: Can falsify or check implementation; cannot establish an arbitrary-input theorem.
admission.known_algorithms: Classify exact rediscoveries as reference material before execution. Do not fill D1 with a known exponential algorithm.

subclass_firewall.promotion_rule: A structural subclass requires a polynomial total reduction/cover from every 3-CNF, exact SAT combination semantics, and a proof that all outputs satisfy the restriction.
subclass_firewall.strictness_note: Excluding some original instances alone does not prove absence of NP-hardness.
